'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Siege of North Gaza]], [[Attacks on refugee camps in the Gaza war]]
****At least twelve [[Palestinian]]s are killed and several others are injured in [[Israel]]i airstrikes on a school used to shelter [[displaced people]] in the [[Al-Shati refugee camp]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/7/at-least-12-displaced-palestinians-killed-in-israeli-strike-on-gaza-school (Al Jazeera)]
**[[List of military aid to Israel during the Gaza war|Military aid to Israel during the Gaza war]], [[Israel–United States military relations]]
***The [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Israeli Ministry of Defence]] announces that it has signed an agreement to acquire 25 [[Boeing F-15EX Eagle II|F-15EX]] fighter jets from [[Boeing]] as part of a $5.2 billion aid package from the [[U.S. government]]. At least four jets will be delivered annually beginning in [[2031]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-signs-deal-acquire-25-f-15-fighter-jets-boeing-co-2024-11-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Zaporizhzhia strikes (2022–present)|Zaporizhzhia strikes]]
***Four people are killed and 33 others are injured when [[Russia|Russian]] [[guided bomb|guided bombs]] hit residences, an apartment building, and a medical center in [[Zaporizhzhia]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attack-ukraines-zaporizhzhia-damages-oncology-ward-kills-four-2024-11-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[2024 eastern Gezira State massacres]]
***At least 73 people from the village of [[Al Hilaliya|al-Hilaliya]], [[Gezira State]], [[Sudan]], are killed by unknown causes during a siege of the village by [[Rapid Support Forces]] militants. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/dozens-die-mysterious-illness-besieged-sudan-town-2024-11-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Hezbollah]] launches [[drone warfare|drones]] at the [[Israeli Defense Forces]] base in [[Kfar Bilu]] and the [[Haifa naval base]] in [[Haifa]], [[Israel]]. No casualties are reported. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/7/hezbollah-attack-drones-target-tel-aviv-army-base-as-israel-pounds-lebanon (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.saba.ye/en/news3393272.htm (Saba News Agency)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023–2024 South American drought]]
**The [[United Nations]] reports that almost a half million children in the [[Amazon rainforest|Amazon]] are currently experiencing significant [[Food security|food]] and [[water scarcity]] due to prolonged [[drought]]s. [https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2024/nov/07/severe-drought-children-food-water-school-amazon-climate-rivers-transport-unicef (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]], [[2024 Cuba blackouts]]
**[[Cuba]] experiences a nationwide [[power outage|blackout]] as [[Hurricane Rafael (2024)|Hurricane Rafael]] makes landfall in [[Artemisa Province]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/7/entire-island-of-cuba-without-power-after-passage-of-hurricane-rafael (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[British government]] announces 56 sanctions on individuals and entities based in countries including [[China]] and [[Turkey]], as well as on the [[Africa Corps (Russia)|Africa Corps]] mercenary group, in order to target [[Russia]]'s [[military-industrial complex]] and restrict the supply of [[arms trafficking|military equipment]] to Russia. [https://www.reuters.com/world/new-uk-sanctions-russia-also-target-africa-corps-2024-11-07/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/7/uk-blacklists-mercenary-groups-in-africa-in-latest-sanctions-against-russia (Al Jazeera)]
*[[France–Israel relations]]
**[[Israel Police]] forcibly enter the [[France|French]]-administered [[Church of the Pater Noster]] compound in [[Jerusalem]] and detain two [[Consulate General of France, Jerusalem|French consulate employees]]. [[Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (France)|French foreign minister]] [[Jean-Noël Barrot]] cancels his visit to the site while the [[French government]] summons the [[Aliza Bin-Noun|Israeli ambassador]] in response. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2024/11/07/diplomatic-incident-occurs-in-jerusalem-on-sidelines-of-french-foreign-minister-s-visit_6732054_4.html (''Le Monde'')] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-france-netanyahu-war-gaza-lebanon-macron-church-3f14d060106160b10cbc8abbd3825f7a (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Chinese intelligence activity abroad]]
**[[Germany]] arrests an [[Americans|American citizen]] suspected of [[espionage|spying]] on the [[U.S. military]] for [[China]] while working at a [[List of United States Army installations in Germany|U.S. military installation in Germany]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/7/germany-arrests-us-national-accused-of-spying-for-china (Al Jazeera)]
*Police in [[Argentina]] charge three people in the death of English singer [[Liam Payne]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/liam-payne-three-charged-in-connection-with-death-of-one-direction-star-prosecutors-office-says-13250215 (Sky News)] [https://people.com/liam-payne-death-three-people-charged-8741765 (''People'')]
*The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] announces an inquiry into a widespread [[Plantation Group text messages|text message harassment campaign]] targeting Black Americans with threats of enslavement. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/09/us/racist-texts-black-people-investigation-what-we-know/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/nbcblk/black-people-text-messages-picking-cotton-nearest-plantation-rcna179036 (NBC)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 German government crisis]]
**[[Volker Wissing]], [[Germany]]'s [[Federal Ministry for Digital and Transport|transport minister]] and the former [[Free Democratic Party (Germany)|Free Democratic Party]] (FDP) general secretary, announces that he will leave the FDP but will remain in the [[Scholz cabinet]]. [https://www.sueddeutsche.de/politik/wissing-lindner-fdp-verkehrsminister-scholz-lux.UwKykUzfSfEwUzLwki2U4d (SZ)]
*[[Second presidential transition of Donald Trump]]
**[[President-elect of the United States|U.S. President-elect]] [[Donald Trump]] [[Second cabinet of Donald Trump|announces]] [[Susie Wiles]] as his [[White House Chief of Staff]], the first woman to serve in this position. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/president-elect-trump-names-campaign-chief-susie-wiles-115622540 (ABC News)]
*The Labor Ministry of [[Ecuador]] temporarily suspends [[Vice President of Ecuador|Vice President]] and ambassador to Israel [[Verónica Abad Rojas]] until April 2025 for failing to comply with an order to leave Israel due to security concerns in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuador-government-suspends-vice-president-office-ahead-2025-elections-2024-11-09/ (Reuters)]
